title: pici workflow
description: A pici workflow, stored as `.ci/<workflow>/ci.yml`. See https://github.com/Thiht/pici for the full documentation.

$schema.description: URL of the JSON Schema for this file. Editors use it for validation and completion; pici ignores it at runtime.

name.description: Workflow name. Defaults to the name of the folder under `.ci/`.

image.description: Docker image to run the steps in, instead of building the workflow's `Dockerfile`. Example: `node:20`.

env.description: Environment variables injected into every step.

on.description: Events that trigger the workflow. Accepts an event name, a list of event names, or a mapping with per-event filters. An empty value (`on:` or `on: {}`) means the workflow only runs when started by hand.

paths.description: Globs (relative to the repo root). The workflow only runs when a push or pull request changes a matching file.

paths_ignore.description: Globs (relative to the repo root) excluded from `paths`.

cache.description: Paths (relative to the repo root) persisted between runs in a project-wide Docker volume.

concurrency.description: Concurrency group. Starting an execution in this group cancels the one already running for the project.

steps.description: The steps of the workflow. Independent steps run in parallel.

name.description: Step name, unique within the workflow.

script.description: Path to a script, relative to `.ci/<workflow>/`. Run through its shebang if present, otherwise through the interpreter matching its extension (`.sh`, `.py`, `.js`, `.rb`, `.go`, ...).

run.description: An arbitrary shell command, run with `sh -c`. Alternative to `script`.

depends_on.description: Names of the steps that must succeed first. A failed step skips its dependents.

env.description: Environment variables injected into this step only.

retry.description: Number of additional attempts after the first failure.

artifacts.description: Globs (relative to the repo root) of files to collect after a successful step.

docker.description: Declare that the workflow needs Docker. The whole workflow then runs in a throwaway sandbox daemon, removed when the execution ends. Defaults to false.

refFilter.description: Restrict an event to matching branch and/or tag refs. An empty value matches everything.

pullRequestFilter.description: Restrict the `pull_request` event. The filter matches the target (base) branch.

push.description: Run on branch and tag pushes.

pull_request.description: Run on pull requests. Pull requests opened from a fork never trigger a run automatically.

manual.description: Restrict the refs that manual runs (CLI, web UI, `--local`) may use. Only accepts a mapping.

schedule.description: Cron expression. Runs on the project's default branch and is never filtered by `paths`.
